# Test Report

## Finding One

Formative assessment works well across many contexts according to a very large body of research [1] [2] [3] [4] [5] and replicated across systems [6] [7] [8]. The run executed all eight phases of the pipeline in deep mode. Retrieval registered 30 sources with stable cryptographic identities, and evidence was persisted to an append-only store before synthesis began, with the route recorded in the run manifest.

## Finding Two

Guided play outperforms direct instruction on selected outcomes [9] [10] [11] [12]. The fallback chain was used because the search CLI was unavailable on this harness.
